name: logs_stderr_ratio_anomaly
title: Share of stderr log lines is unusually high
description: Share of pod log lines written to stderr (log_iostream = 'stderr') is above its learned band in at least 2 of the last 3 five-minute buckets; the collector parses no log level, so stderr is the available error proxy. Unit: ratio 0-1. Ratios are floored at 1% (0.01) and buckets with fewer than 100 lines report the floor. Edit the two constants in custom_sql to tune. Whole stream; add a WHERE clause on k8s_cluster or k8s_namespace_name after install for a per-entity alert (one config per entity). Requires the log_iostream attribute set by the OpenObserve collector's filelog receiver; on a logs stream without it, training fails with 'No field named log_iostream' and keeps retrying.

anomaly_config.custom_sql: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '5m') AS time_bucket, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) < 100 THEN 0.01 ELSE GREATEST(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN log_iostream = 'stderr' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE), 0.01) END AS stderr_ratio FROM "default" GROUP BY time_bucket ORDER BY time_bucket
